name: Indiana Championship 2027

venue.name: The Commons
venue.details: Nugent-Custer Performance Hall on the 2nd floor

information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA4MTk5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--eb570dfb9a740dbc378bc5fdfa55473c8cbdb768/Untitled%20-%20July%2025,%202026%20at%2008.35.43.png) Competitors may bring in outside food & non alcoholic beverages. There will not be any on site concessions available. The venue features a free indoor playground on the first floor for families. There is a moving sculpture that runs in the lobby and can also be viewed from the competition floor. The venue is 100% ADA Accessible with elevators, escalators & stage ramps. The street parking and parking garage next door are all FREE on weekends. Across the street from the venue you can find a Children's museum, Historical Ice Cream Parlor/Museum and various other stores & eateries. There are chain restaurants scattered around the city. Lodging: The Hotel Indigo is just down from the venue and recently renovated. Near the interstate are other hotel chain options. This competition is being supported by Midwest Cubing Association. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAxNDAxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--aa70961c45e516f93aab733a0e5d3d9a432be2ea/image.jpeg)
